scope: Metadata-only research of exactly two new official pretrained reader candidates. No weights, model initialization, tokenizer initialization, native initialization, project labels, or project test results were read or executed.

overall.modernbert: HOLD: checkpoint-specific fine-tuning/selection lineage is not established; binary not_entailment cannot supply a native three-way legal decision.
overall.qwen3: CONDITIONAL_METADATA_ELIGIBLE_NOT_QUALIFIED: official licensed foundation checkpoint can support a future frozen typed-score prototype. Unknown foundation/SFT overlap is retained as unknown, not treated as proof of contamination. Typed-score correctness, calibration, project-unused confirmation, and bounded CPU completion have not been qualified.
overall.pretraining_overlap: Unknown for both candidates. This report does not require impossible global pretraining record provenance and does not infer clean separation from absent evidence.

cached_runtime.inspection: importlib.metadata only; no torch, transformers, tokenizers, model, or native imports
cached_runtime.important_correction: The cached runtime is new enough for both candidates; the initial warning about an old 4.x runtime was not confirmed.

base.base_revision_used_by_finetune: Not pinned in the fine-tuned checkpoint card/config; current base revision is not proof of training-time identity.
base.license: Apache-2.0 explicitly declared in official base card for architecture, weights, and training code

architecture.pooling: attention-mask-weighted mean, then prediction head, dropout, and a two-output linear classifier
architecture.probability_semantics: softmax(logits)[0] is the learned binary entailment score. not_entailment merges contradiction and neutral/absence; it cannot be relabeled as contradiction. Per-hypothesis scores are not a calibrated three-way legal decision probability.

licenses.checkpoint: Apache-2.0 declared in official model card; no separate LICENSE file listed in this model repository
licenses.upstream_data: Not one blanket Apache license. Official dataset overview includes noncommercial and unknown licenses; complete checkpoint-specific source license reconciliation is absent.

training_selection_calibration.checkpoint_card: Says it fine-tunes the same dataset mix as zeroshot-v2.0, but does not bind an exact training code revision, data revisions, record manifest, or calibration set.
training_selection_calibration.source_limit: This generic v2 notebook predates the ModernBERT release and is not a verified training receipt for this exact checkpoint.

train_sources_in_generic_v2_code.sampling: maximum 50000 per config after shuffle seed 42

train_sources_in_generic_v2_code.role: alternate commercially-friendly path; exact checkpoint path not established

training_selection_calibration.selection_evidence_in_generic_code: dataset_test_concat_nli['train'] is encoded as encoded_dataset_test; Trainer eval_dataset uses it; evaluation_strategy='epoch', load_best_model_at_end=True, metric_for_best_model='f1_macro'. Thus nominal test data is used for checkpoint selection in the published generic recipe. This is not proof that the exact ModernBERT release used that recipe unchanged.
training_selection_calibration.record_level_project_confirmation_nonove: Not established. No project-unused source-licensed confirmation manifest was supplied or inspected. No confirmation labels were used.

bounded_cpu.cpu_source_behavior: Installed 4.52.4 ModernBERT source explicitly disables reference_compile for cpu. Future smoke should force CPU and eager/sdpa with reference_compile=False, avoiding GPU flash-attention assumptions.
bounded_cpu.weights_bytes_observed_as_metadata_only: Approximately 792 MB BF16; weights were not downloaded.
bounded_cpu.under_2cpu_600s: Unverified. Public speed claims in this card concern GPU throughput and do not establish this CPU budget.
bounded_cpu.semantic_limit: Binary head cannot directly produce entailment/contradiction/not-mentioned, regardless of CPU feasibility.

new_blockers_once: No checkpoint-specific train/selection/calibration manifest; generic published recipe selects checkpoints with a nominal test set.
Binary not_entailment collapses contradiction and neutral, so a new fixed and independently qualified typed-decision mapping would be required.
Complete source-data license reconciliation and a project-unused confirmation manifest are not established.

base.training_time_base_revision: not pinned in instruction checkpoint card

architecture.parameter_count_caution: Instruction and base Hub entry counts differ by one 151936 x 1024 embedding-sized matrix, while config tie_word_embeddings is true. Do not silently substitute advertised size for serialized entry count or claim resolution without inspecting weights in a separately authorized step.
architecture.head: Causal vocabulary LM head, not an NLI classifier.
architecture.probability_semantics: Full-vocabulary softmax gives next-token probabilities conditioned on the frozen prompt. Renormalizing three fixed legal decision code logits gives a conditional choice score, not a calibrated probability that the legal proposition is true. Token IDs, prompt, code mapping, thinking=False, and any suffix must be frozen before independent confirmation. Prefer one forward pass with logits_to_keep=1 after verifying the label codes are each one token; no open-ended reasoning generation.

licenses.foundation_data_source_licenses: Not enumerated at record level; weight licensing is documented, global training-text rights and overlap are not proven. Retain as unknown.

training_selection_calibration.pretraining: Official report section 3 describes approximately 36T multilingual tokens including web, books, PDF-derived and synthetic text, with three training stages. Dataset names, revisions, record manifests, and full source license chains are not published there.
training_selection_calibration.small_model_posttraining: Section 4.5 specifically includes 0.6B in off-policy response distillation and on-policy logit/KL distillation using Qwen3-32B or Qwen3-235B-A22B teachers. Generic four-stage flagship RL descriptions must not be assigned uncritically to the 0.6B release.
training_selection_calibration.train_dev_selection_ids: Not provided for this exact distilled checkpoint. The report mentions a reserved validation query set in the flagship cold-start process, but no record-level linkage to 0.6B distillation or a legal decision calibration set.
training_selection_calibration.known_contractnli_finetune_or_selection_: None established by the inspected official metadata; absence of disclosure is not evidence of absence or evidence of overlap.
training_selection_calibration.foundation_overlap_policy: Retain unknown; do not reject solely because global pretraining/SFT records are undisclosed.
training_selection_calibration.project_specific_confirmation: Not yet established as source-licensed, project-unused, frozen, and separate from prompt selection/calibration. No confirmation labels were read or used.

bounded_cpu.installed_source_semantics: 4.52.4 source supports logits_to_keep and the causal LM head. Exact installed file hashes recorded separately.
bounded_cpu.memory_and_time: One bounded prefill and one-step typed scoring is structurally cheaper than generation, but model load, prompt length, pair count, memory, and completion within 2 CPU / 600 seconds were not measured. BF16 CPU speed cannot be assumed.

new_blockers_once: No frozen typed-decision prompt/code adapter and no independent qualification of its scores or abstention behavior.
No admitted source-licensed project-unused confirmation manifest separate from prompt selection/calibration.
No observed CPU time/RSS proof for the exact bounded workload.
what_is_not_a_blocker: Transformers architecture version: cached runtime supports qwen3.
Unknown foundation training text overlap alone: remains an acknowledged uncertainty, not invented contamination proof.

source_dependency_pins.actual_cached_transformers: 4.52.4; exact local source SHA256s in cached-runtime-source.json are authoritative for a future run, not the older inspected tag.

independent_native_experiment_recommenda.name: Pinned native cosine correctness across insertion order and persisted reload
independent_native_experiment_recommenda.purpose: Qualify useful native numerical behavior independently of the raw grammar parser and exposed legal questions.
independent_native_experiment_recommenda.inputs: New fixed analytic 384D vectors and query vectors with a recorded generator/version/seed and CC0 declaration; no model initialization or QA labels. Include ordinary separated vectors, near ties, rescaled vectors, and declared finite-input limits.
independent_native_experiment_recommenda.oracle: Exact float64 cosine top-k with tie-tolerant set acceptance and frozen tolerance. Explicitly define handling of zero norms before execution.
independent_native_experiment_recommenda.matched_comparison: Same pinned native binary and vectors, at least two insertion orders, before and after persisted reload; fixed k and fixed HNSW parameters. No parameter grid and no selection on exposed questions.
independent_native_experiment_recommenda.interpretation_limit: Native numerical/retrieval engineering evidence only. It cannot establish legal decision accuracy or benchmark gains.
